description.en:
"I have no interest in real girls!" So claims Okumura, the president of the school's manga club. He's your typical otaku, obsessed with a sexy (fictional) 2D manga character known as Liliel. Then the new school year starts, and a (real!) 3D girl named Lilysa whose passion is cosplay joins the club. Lilysa convinces Okumura to become her photographer–and guess who her favorite manga character is? Not only that, but Lilysa is into modeling the fetishy stuff, The boundaries between 2D and 3D start to blur as this hot-blooded romantic comedy unfolds.

description.en:
Haruyoshi Kuga's power as the strongest exorcist is all for naught when he is betrayed by his closest ally. With his dying breath, he casts the secret Spell of Reincarnation — when he next opens his eyes, he finds himself in a different world altogether, reincarnated as Seika Lamprogue, the son of a family of magic scholars! He quickly learns that the magic in this new world is quite unlike the sorcery he learned in his past life and that he can't use it. Fortunately for him, with his mastery of curses and the hordes of youkai at his disposal, he doesn't need to. 

Haruyoshi (now Seika) is determined not to repeat his past mistakes in his second life by smartly laying low and avoiding flaunting his power. Yet accomplishing his goals and without drawing attention to himself proves to be easier said than done — will his powers be enough to live a happy life!?
___

description.en: Handyman Saitou has never been anyone special. All his life, he's had average grades, ordinary athletic skill, a commonplace job… But his unremarkable path takes a turn when he wakes up in another world. Here, warriors, wizards, and elves accompany him on quests delving deep into dungeons, and Saitou realizes for the first time what it's like to be needed. After all, who other than the handyman could be trusted to open locked treasure chests or repair his allies' equipment?
description.es: Saitou es un utilero ordinario que se transporta a otro mundo donde sus habilidades son muy útiles. Empieza a entender realmente lo que significa ser necesario, ya que incluso sus tareas y herramientas mundanas tienen los usos más inesperados en este nuevo mundo de fantasía!
description.ja:
斎藤さんは充実していた。この世界で「ありがとう」を知ったから。今までの人生、ずっと平々凡々と生きてきた。運動も、勉強も、そこそこ。決して一番になれない普通の人間……それが、斎藤さん。

職業“便利屋”の斎藤さんは、ある日、異世界に転生する。そこで出会ったのは、強く美しいツンデレ戦士。ラエルザ呪文を忘れる最強魔法使い。で、エロじじいの　モーロック姿はかわいいが守銭奴の妖精。ラファンパン斎藤さんは個性的すぎる仲間たちとダンジョン攻略に挑む。鍵開けのノウハウで、宝箱を開けたりカバン修理のスキルで、仲間の防具を直したり元の世界で身につけた“便利屋”の経験を異世界で活かす。
description.ru:
Сайто — мастер на все руки, который попадает в другой мир, где его навыки невероятно полезны. Погружаясь в новую среду, он начинает понимать истинное значение незаменимости.
Мастер на все руки Сайто никогда не был особенным. Всю жизнь у него были средние оценки, обычные спортивные навыки, заурядная работа... Но его ничем не примечательная жизнь меняется, когда он просыпается в другом мире. Здесь воины, волшебники и эльфы сопровождают его в заданиях, углубляясь в подземелья, и Сайто впервые осознает, что значит быть нужным. Ведь кому, как не мастеру на все руки, можно доверить открытие запертых сундуков с сокровищами или ремонт снаряжения союзников? История обычного человека, начавшаяся с простого «спасибо», — это история его полноценной жизни.
description.vi: Saitou là một người siêng năng bình thường được chuyển đến một thế giới khác, nơi các kỹ năng của anh ta rất hữu ích. Anh ấy bắt đầu thực sự hiểu ý nghĩa của việc được cần đến.

description.en:
"Understand for yourself that you are worthless. You are already obsolete."

Dion, the recovery wizard who was told so, was seriously injured by the hands of party members and left behind in the interior of the highest difficulty dungeon. On the verge of running out of his life, he happens to encounter a dying dragon. Dion realized that he couldn't help him anymore, and he treated the dragon to live as a recovery wizard until the end. Then the dragon thanked him and even shared the power of the dragon. In addition, this dragon seems to have been a legendary god dragon-class. Dion escapes from the dungeon with his new companion, the dragon, and restarts as an adventurer. He captures the difficult dungeons that stand in his way, and his abilities are recognized and he has all the strong men on his side.

Besoknya, dia berencana membuang manga yang ditolak tersebut, namun, salah satu gadis dari kelasnya, Miyamoto Niina, mengetahui manga hasil buatannya, timbulah kisah komedi-romantis yang terjalin dari sebuah manga!
description.ja: ２次元をこよなく愛する上原くんの夢は漫画家！！しかし、漫画家への第一歩と持ち込んだラブコメ漫画を「恋愛にリアリティが無い」と一蹴され、夢を諦めようとしていた…。そんな彼の原稿を同じクラスのギャル・宮本さんが目にしたとき、一生交わるはずのなかった２人の漫画のための疑似恋愛、開始――！？漫画のための隠し事！活かして夢見る描く仕事！
description.tr: Her zaman aklı iki boyutlu dünyada olan Yuuki Uehara, çizdiği mangada mükemmel romantik komedi karakterini -mütevazi, şapşik ve bakire Şirayşi Kiyone’yi- yaratmayı başarmıştır! Fakat mangasını favori yayımcısının editörüne götürdüğünde ondan aynı sözleri duyamaz. Editör hikayenin klişe ve gerçekçilikten çok uzak olduğunu söylediğinde Uehara’nın dünyası başına yıkılır. Bu umutsuzlukla dolaşırken karşısına onunla aynı kaderi paylaşan, tebessümü yüzünden düşmeyen, güzeller güzeli sınıf arkadaşı Niyna Miyamoto çıkar. Miyamoto da Uehara gibi gelecekte mangaka olmak isteyen fakat gerçekçi olmayan hikayesiyle reddedilen bir yetenektir. Uehara’nın da aynı sorundan muzdarip olduğunu duyunca Miyamoto’nun ağzından şu kelimeler dökülür: “Neden benimle çıkmıyorsun?!“ İşte o anda ikisi daha iyi birer mangaka olabilmek için sahte bir çift oluverirler! Fakat ne Miyamoto, Uehara’nın mükemmel ana karakterine ne de Uehara; Miyamoto’nun burnu havada, havalı karakterine benzemektedir. Bu aralarındaki garip ilişki, gerçekten onların hayallerine yakınlaşabilmelerini sağlayabilecek midir yoksa daha tuhaf ve gülünç olaylara mı sebebiyet verecektir?
description.vi:
Uehara-kun là một thằng rất thích gái 2D và ước mơ làm hoạ sĩ Manga! Tuy nhiên, giấc mơ của anh ta lại ngay lập tức bị đạp đổ khi bị một biên tập viên nhận xét rằng tác phẩm này nhìn chán chả buồn nói.

Tưởng như anh đã định từ bỏ giấc mơ của mình thì một cô gái trong lớp của anh, Miyamoto Niina, nhìn thấy bản phác thảo của cậu ấy và muốn bắt đầu một mối tình tưởng lãng mạn nhưng ai ngờ là giả tạo, để giúp cậu hoàn thành được bộ manga của mình!

Một bộ manga về Mangaka ✖ Romcom tuổi mới lớn!
description.pt-br:
Uehara-kun, que adora 2D, sonha em se tornar um mangaká um dia! No entanto, seu sonho é ameaçado quando um editor rejeita seu trabalho por considerá-lo muito chato.

No dia seguinte, enquanto pensa em desistir de seu sonho, uma garota de sua turma, Miyamoto Niina, vê seu manuscrito, e um pseudo-romance muito próximo para o bem de seus mangás começa!?

Esta é uma comédia romântica juvenil de quadrinistas!

description.en:
When it comes to the fantasy MMORPG Cross Reverie, none can match the power of the Demon King Diablo. Possessing the game's rarest artifacts and an unrivaled player level, he overpowers all foolish enough to confront him. But despite his fearsome reputation, Diablo's true identity is Takuma Sakamoto, a shut-in gamer devoid of any social skills. Defeating hopeless challengers day by day, Takuma cares about nothing else but his virtual life—that is, until a summoning spell suddenly transports him to another world where he has Diablo's appearance!

In this new world resembling his favorite game, Takuma is greeted by the two girls who summoned him: Rem Galeu, a petite Pantherian adventurer, and Shera L. Greenwood, a busty Elf summoner. They perform an Enslavement Ritual in an attempt to subjugate him, but the spell backfires and causes them to become his slaves instead. With the situation now becoming more awkward than ever, Takuma decides to accompany the girls in finding a way to unbind their contract while learning to adapt to his new existence as the menacing Demon King.
description.ja: ＭＭＯＲＰＧクロスレヴェリで「魔王」の異名を持つプレイヤー、坂本拓真。ある日、拓真がいつもの眠りから目覚めると、眼前には「私こそが召喚主」と言い張る美少女2人と、見慣れたゲームそっくりの世界が広がっていた。彼はゲーム内の姿で、異世界へと召喚されてしまったのだ！
description.ru: В MMORPG «Перекрёсток мечтаний» [Король демонов] это игрок, а звать его Сакамото Такума. Одним прекрасным днем, пробудившись ото сна, Такума обнаружил перед собой два очаровательных создания. «Это я призвала его!» – перед ним между собой спорили девушки. Мир вокруг него оказался копией знакомой игры. Он стал ее персонажем, он был вызван в другой мир! Навык общения равен нулю, и поэтому герой вынужден отыгрывать привычную роль Короля демонов. Приключение в другом мире с абсолютной силой Короля демонов, полученной в игре, начинается!
description.pt-br: Sakamoto Takuma é jogador de um Mmorpg chamado Cross Reverie. Sakamoto na vida real é um neet que possui dificuldade de se comunicar com o sexo oposto, mas por outro lado, no jogo ele é tão forte e popular que passou a ser chamado pelos outros jogadores de Rei Demônio. Certo dia depois de uma noite de sono, ao acordar, Sakamoto percebe que não está mais em seu quarto, e sim em um mundo similar a Cross Reverie. Lá ele encontra duas garotas que dizem tê-lo invocado e proclamam ser suas mestras, sem saber como agir por ter dificuldade de lidar com garotas, ele toma o papel que interpretava no jogo online e começa a agir como um verdadeiro Rei Demônio. O que irá acontecer com ele neste mundo, e por que foi invocado? Esta é a historia do Rei Demônio (em exercício) que irá inspirar todo o mundo com suas aventuras.

"Jin... I'm expelling you from the party."

description.en: A gate appears in Tokyo's Ginza district sometime in the 21st century. From the gate pours out monsters, knights from middle-age Europe, and other fantasy-like beings, and they kill many of the citizens of Tokyo. This event is known as the Ginza Incident. The government sends a small group of soldiers from the Japanese Self-Defense Forces to the alternate world beyond the gate. Led by otaku soldier Youji, they find that the villages in the world are being attacked by a dragon. An elf girl who is a survivor from the dragon's rampage joins the group in their travels across the dangerous new world.

Từ cánh cổng đó đổ ra những con quái vật, những chiến binh từ thời Trung Âu, những thứ chỉ có trong tưởng tượng khác và chúng đã giết chết rất nhiều người dân của Tokyo. Sự kiện này được biết đến với cái tên Ginza Incident. Chính phủ đã gửi một nhóm nhỏ các binh sĩ của Lực lượng Phòng vệ Nhật Bản (thay cho lực lượng quân đội) để đến thế giới bên kia cánh cổng. Được dẫn dắt bởi người lính otaku, và họ đã nhìn thấy một ngôi làng đang bị tấn công bỏi một con rồng. description.id:
Liam sera banfield adalah reincarnator. dia bereinkarnasi di dunia fantasy pedang dan sihir. Tapi pada saat peradaban sudah siap membuat kemajuan ke luar angkasa, ceritanya terjadi di sebuah kerajaan antar galaksi, sebuah universitas seperti opera ruang angkasa di mana senjata humanoid dan pesawat ruang angkasa saling melengkapi. Liam, yang telah menjelma menjadi keluarga bangsawan dalam masyarakat monarki. memiliki ambisi untuk suatu hari menjadi raja jahat di kehidupan sebelumnya. sayangnya Liam telah kehilangan segalanya dan mati dalam keputusasaan. 

"sangat bodoh hidup untuk orang lain."
 "Aku akan hidup untuk diriku sendiri"

 ia mulai menuju kehidupan keduanya, tetapi malah disembah sebagai penguasa yang berbudi luhur karena perbedaan nilainya. Akankah Liam dapat dengan aman menjadi tuan yang jahat?
description.ja:
星間国家アルグランド帝国の辺境惑星を治める伯爵家に転生し、幼くして領主となったリアム・セラ・バンフィールド。持ち前の善良さ故に、妻や会社に裏切られた前世の反省から今世では“奪う側”として生きると決意する――

「悪徳領主になって、悪の限りを尽くす！」

だが、受け継いだ領地は虐げるまでもない寂れっぷりで……止む無くリアムは自領の建て直しから着手することに。人工知能を重用！ 宇宙艦隊を縮小！不正貴族を一刀両断！常識など無視して思うがまま傍若無人に振る舞うのだが、結果的に領民は豊かになり、好感度がうなぎ登りで……！？
description.vi: Đến từ tác giả của Sevens và Otomob Liam Sera Banfield là một người chuyển sinh. Cậu được tái sinh vào một vũ trụ giả tưởng mà ở đó cả khoa học lẫn ma thuật đều phát triển. Ở kiếp trước, cậu đã mất tất cả để rồi chêt trong tuyệt vọng: -Nếu đó là những gì nhận được khi sống tử tế, tôi thà sống buông thả. -Ta sẽ trở thành một chúa tể độc ác! Liệu con đường trở thành chúa tể độc ác của cậu có được như ý muốn?
description.pt-br: Liam Sera Canfield é um reincarnator. Ele reencarnou em um universo fantasioso de espada e feitiçaria, onde a civilização já avançou para o espaço sideral. A história se passa em um império intergaláctico, assim como uma space opera, com armas humanoides e batalhas de naves espaciais. Liam, que incarnou em uma família de aristocratas em uma sociedade monárquica, tem a ambição de se tornar um lorde maligno. Em sua vida anterior, liam infelizmente acabou perdendo tudo e morrendo em desespero. “ É tolice viver pelos outros.” “ Eu irei viver por mim mesmo” Com esses sentimentos no peito ele começa sua segunda vida, só que ao invés disso ele é idolatrado como um virtuoso líder por causa da diferença de valores. Será que Liam conseguirá se tornar um lorde maligno?

description.pt-br:
Shinichi Honda é um estudante sem filtro para suas palavras ou ações. Um estudante do primeiro ano do ensino médio, ele é nobre e gentil, mas tão rude como um tijolo, tende a falar o que pensa sem hesitação. Freqüentando a mesma escola está Mako Wakamiya, uma membra do comitê de moral pública com um incrível senso de dever. À distância, ela parece ser fria e controlada, mas escondido à vista de todos está o fato de que ela é uma total desastrada com coração de donzela.

A primeira vez que Shinichi e Mako se olham, cada um deles está totalmente preso em sua própria situação embaraçosa. O breve momento em que eles passam um pelo outro só os deixa estupefatos com a estranha aparência do outro.

Meses depois, ocorre um desastre quando Mako, em serviço de comitê, deve confiscar um mangá adulto de Shinichi. A hilaridade segue quando Shinichi lidera Mako em uma perseguição estrondosa por toda a escola. Como o par ensurdecedor acontece de se encontrar cada vez com mais frequência, talvez haja esperança de que os dois possam se dar bem?

A god of a different world had abruptly appeared in Kamiya Yato's classroom and forcibly summoned the entire class to his world... except for him, because he was sleeping in a seat in the corner of the class, the round summoning magic circle didn't reach him, and he ended up staying here on Earth, but with brand-new skills.

After he made it through a whole year full of police interviews and journalism reports, he finally became a high school student, but the quiet days he had hoped for were far from over; be it terrorists who decide to occupy his school or even monsters from different world, one by one new incidents take place in the town he lives in...

Will a boy without any motivation be able to save the world?
___
Note: No raw updates since October 2021; assume hiatus by author. Comic Boost still lists the series as an "irregular serialization" rather than axed, so there remains a slim possibility for future updates.

После целого года допросов полицейскими и интервью с журналистами, он наконец поступил в старшую школу, но спокойные дни, которых он так желал, уже давно кончились. Будь то террористы, решившие захватить школу, или монстры из иного мира, в городе, где он живет, происходят одно событие за другим…

Nhưng tiếc thay cậu lại ngồi cuối lớp và không nằm trong vòng ma pháp nên đã bị bỏ xót lại. Liệu câu chuyện cảu cậu sẽ kết thúc lãng xẹt như vậy ư....

Thanks to various magic, the human race has been saved from calamity many, many times. Retaining his memories from his previous life, a boy, Shin, was picked up by an old man known to the world as the "Magi." Shin was brought up by the Magi, who had retired to a secular place, as his own grandson. With the memories of his past life, he absorbed the Magi's craft and grew to be able to develop his own magic. Then, the grandfather told him he has to become independent when he reaches the age of 15.

The grandson who has grown beyond the level of normal people, lacked common sense; the common sense of the world. So to learn how to socialize, he goes to Earlshide Kingdom City to be admitted to Earlshide Advanced Magic Academy.

“Carlo Zen” is the alias of a Japanese novelist and game scenario writer. Almost nothing is known about his real identity. His pseudonym is taken from [the Venetian admiral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carlo_Zeno).

Zen began releasing *Youjo Senki* on the web novel site Arcardia in March 2012. In June 2013, Enterbrain began publishing it as a light novel series. Seeing great success, [manga](https://mangadex.org/title/d773c8be-8e82-4ff1-a4e9-46171395319b) and anime adaptations followed.

He also participated in scenario writing for the game adaptation of *Chaos Dragon: Chaos War* and the original story creator of *Juuma no Reza Nation*.

He loves the humanities and social sciences, especially when associated with international relations and history. He's a huge fan of simulation and strategy games, especially Paradox Interactive's.

Zen is also a [Toshiya Wakabayashi](https://mangadex.org/author/f2ad1810-2f01-4889-a206-24642a0f4646) fan.

description.en:
The final hour of the popular virtual reality game Yggdrasil has come. However, Momonga, a powerful wizard and master of the dark guild Ainz Ooal Gown, decides to spend his last few moments in the game as the servers begin to shut down. To his surprise, despite the clock having struck midnight, Momonga is still fully conscious as his character and, moreover, the non-player characters appear to have developed personalities of their own!  

Confronted with this abnormal situation, Momonga commands his loyal servants to help him investigate and take control of this new world, with the hopes of figuring out what has caused this development and if there may be others in the same predicament.

---

Note: Due to unknown circumstances, the series was ended at Chapter 78 and continued in a new series as [Overlord: New World](https://mangadex.org/title/73320da2-eac6-4ff5-a12d-30788624d85b).
description.ru: Бежать из тягостной повседневности, покорить дивный новый мир, стать неуязвимым и бессмертным суперменом – такова мечта пресловутого «офисного планктона». Типичный его представитель, сражавшийся в недалеком будущем в виртуальную РПГ «Иггдрасиль» под ником Момонга, не захотел покидать закрывающуюся игру. Зачем же уходить из обжитой иллюзии, если можно даром получить целый мир для себя, любимого?! И вот она у твоих ног – иная реальность, что рождается в мировом ничто, а неигровые персонажи, бездушные программы на глазах обретают сюжетную плоть и кровь. Кого волнует, что приходится странствовать в образе костлявого лича? Ведь ты всемогущ, прикажи – и красотка Альбедо воспылает страстью, а вампирша Шальтир будет ее отчаянно ревновать. Не стоит размышлять, Будда ты или бабочка на цветке лотоса: бей, руби, люби – в сказке можно все!
description.es-la:
Ha llegado la hora final del popular juego de realidad virtual Yggdrasil. Sin embargo, Momonga, un poderoso mago y maestro del gremio oscuro Ainz Ooal Gown, decide pasar sus últimos momentos en el juego mientras los servidores comienzan a cerrarse. Para su sorpresa, a pesar de que el reloj ha dado la medianoche, Momonga sigue plenamente consciente como su personaje y, además, ¡los personajes no jugadores parecen haber desarrollado personalidades propias!  
Ante esta situación anómala, Momonga ordena a sus leales servidores que le ayuden a investigar y a tomar el control de este nuevo mundo, con la esperanza de averiguar qué ha provocado esta evolución y si puede haber otros en la misma situación.
description.pt-br:
Momonga é um assalariado médio que passa seu tempo livre jogando Yggdrasil, um DMMO-RPG bem conhecido no Japão por seu imenso mundo e personalização ilimitada. Infelizmente, todas as coisas boas chegam ao fim, e os servidores de Yggdrasil fecham no ano de 2138. Querendo testemunhar as horas finais do jogo, Momonga, o líder da guilda Ainz Ooal Gown, faz login pela última vez e segue em direção à sede da guilda.

Depois de relembrar seus companheiros e aventuras, Momonga se prepara para o servidor desconectá-lo automaticamente quando o relógio bate meia-noite. No entanto, ele não é expulso do jogo à força. Em vez disso, ele se encontra em um novo mundo — agora preso no corpo de seu avatar e onde os personagens NPC estão cientes de seus sentimentos.

Sem outras opções, Momonga assume o nome de sua guilda na esperança de que outros jogadores reconheçam Ainz Ooal Gown. Determinado a dar sentido à situação bizarra, Momonga embarca em uma jornada para desvendar os mistérios ocultos neste mundo desconhecido.

---

Tu ne le sais pas encore, mais tu m’adores !

Mona plaît à tout le monde, c’est comme ça. Son sourire, son allure, sa personnalité… Tout chez elle attire les gens. Dans son lycée, elle fait tourner toutes les têtes. Sauf celle d’un garçon… Medaka. Fraîchement admis dans son école, celui-ci a complètement chamboulé la vie de cette fille à qui nul ni personne n’est censé résister. description.en:
It was in the year 2800 of the Midgard calendar. Back then, there was a Overlord who once reigned supreme and had reached the very brink of subduing the world. Her name was Lufasu Mafaalu, a great woman dreaded as the Black-Winged Overlord. She was too strong, too fast, and too beautiful. However, she was defeated by Heroes who opposed her ferocity, and her ambition was brought to an end.  
  
Or so went the story of our protagonist’s in-game character, whose body he now possesses for some reason in a world 200 years after Lufasu’s downfall. Follow our protagonist as he becomes unnecessarily feared by his surroundings and unnecessarily worshiped by his former subordinates as he―or now she―cheerfully travels around this fantasy world.

Имя ей было Люфас Мафаал, великая женщина, которую боялись как Тёмнокрылую Владычицу. Она была слишком сильна, быстра и невероятно красива… Однако, её победили Герои, восставшие против её жестокости, и её амбициям пришел конец… Вернее такой была история игрового персонажа, чьё тело наш главный герой получил по некоторым причинам в мире спустя 200 лет после свержения Люфас. И с этого начинается история увлекательного путешествия по фэнтезийному миру нашего главного героя, или вернее сказать, героини.

クラス内カーストトップの清楚ギャル・茨戸七海に罰ゲームで告白されて付き合うことになった陰キャ男子・簾舞陽信。 しかし罰ゲームのはずが、七海は陽信にガチ惚れしているようで…？
description.pl: Kiedy piękna Nanami Barato wyznaje miłość Yoshinowi Misumai, wydaje się to zbyt piękne, by mogło być prawdziwe! Tylko, że tak jest - i Yoshin o tym wie. Jak taki introwertyczny facet jak on ma zachować zimną krew, skoro wie, że to tylko wyzwanie? Jeszcze bardziej zastanawiające jest to, że pomimo jej krzykliwego wyglądu, ta rzekoma gyaru nie jest tak dobra w kontaktach z facetami! Być może jest to idealna okazja dla tego nieśmiałego faceta, aby zebrać się na odwagę i powiedzieć "tak" tej nieśmiałej dziewczynie. Tak zaczyna się ich nowe, wygodne życie porannych spotkań i ręcznie robionych lunchów. Rzecz w tym, że sądząc po jej zachowaniu, Nanami zakochała się w nim po uszy! Czy ta dwójka może odkryć swoje uczucia, a może nawet zakochać się w sobie - tym razem naprawdę?!
description.pt-br: Barato Nanami, uma versão atenuada da garota no topo da hierarquia da escola, perdeu um jogo de cartas e agora tem que confessar a um cara de sua classe como punição. Misumai Youshin, que é um solitário sem amigos, foi o cara escolhido, mas ele sabe da punição! Deveria ter sido uma punição do jogo, mas será que Nanami vai desenvolver sentimentos por Youshin…?

After transferring schools, Atsumu is now determined to live a normal life, but as he crosses paths with talented entertainers—VTubers, idols, and models—his natural ability starts to shine, making him their indispensable support. They can't help but adore him, turning his simple wish for normality into a showbiz underdog success story!

description.en:
Workaholic assistant Atobe Arihito fell asleep in his company's bus that was traveling for a vacation. When he awoke he learned he had died due to the bus getting into an accident, and that he had reincarnated into a world of reincarnators - to the Labyrinth Country. To his surprise he was discovered by his slave driving manager, Igarashi Kyouka, who further explains their role in this world.

In Labyrinth Country, Reincarnators are expected to choose a job and form parties to fight against monsters in Labyrinths. "Valkyrie" Kyouka had expected Arihito to work with her once again, but he declines due to his knowledge of her demanding nature. As they depart she vows to make him regret not choosing her.
description.ja: 元社畜のアリヒトが転生先の迷宮国で就いた職業は、正体不明の『後衛』だった。前例のない職業のため誰ともパーティを組めず、アリヒトは亜人の少女テレジアを傭兵に雇うことでなんとかダンジョン探索を始める。しかし、いざ戦闘が始まると『後衛』は攻撃＆防御支援に回復もこなせる万能職のようで……。

While playing this very game in his second account, he was summoned to another world as a character he made, where the people were merrily expecting a hero! However, when it's revealed that he doesn't have the title of a hero, he is discarded and replaced by another person. Now, he must survive in an another world with the account he merely used to store his extra items in.

His mother neglected him. Due to all these trauma stacking with each other, his emotions were completely destroyed. When Yukito enters high school, the girls who inflicted these pain on him started to care for him...!?

description.uk: Коконое Юкіто завжди не щастило, коли справа доходила до жінок. Його відкинув друг дитинства, який, на його думку, мав взаємні почуття один до одного. Сестра ненавидить його. Мати знехтувала ним. Через те, що всі ці травми накладалися одна на одну, його емоції були повністю зруйновані. Коли Юкіто вступає до середньої школи, дівчата, які завдали йому цього болю, почали доглядати за ним...?!
description.es-la:
Yukito Kokonoe siempre ha tenido mala suerte. Es odiado por su madre, su hermana, y su amiga de la infancia, pensaba que tenían sentimientos mutuos, pero ella se siente frustrada antes de la confesión, e incluso hace travesuras durante sus heridas, y sus emociones se rompen después de repetidos traumas con muchas mujeres.

Sin embargo, cuando ingresó a la escuela preparatoria, ¿¡Las chicas que lo traumatizaron comenzaron a preocuparse por él ...!?
Esta es una comedia romántica de un adolescente incomprendido que comienza demasiado tarde.

And since he got "Priest" as a job, his starting Recovery Stat was more than enough to heal any wounds, so he dumped all of his Stat Points into Evasion. In other words, he's aiming for an Evasion Healer who will never get hit by enemy attacks. But unfortunately, people in that world couldn't understand his ideal! The King got angry against him and labelled him as useless almost immediately!
description.ja: 異世界に召喚され、回復職の適性を得たヒロキ。ゲーマーのヒロキはヒーラーの理想形と信じる「回避ヒーラー」になるためにステータスポイントを回避に振るが、異世界ではまったく理解されずに放逐されてしまう。
description.ru: Учащегося среднего специального образовательного учреждения Сакурай Хироки вызвали в иное измерение для того, чтобы одолеть Лорда Демонов. Поскольку он получит специализацию "Клирика", его базового знания в области восстановления хватило в избытке, чтобы врачевать какие угодно повреждения, и по этой причине он использовал все очки способностей для улучшения уклонения. Иначе говоря, он выбрал дорогу исцелителя, который ни за что не окажется под ударами неприятеля. Однако, к несчастью, народ этого измерения не был в состоянии оценить его по достоинству! Правитель рассердился на героя и моментально нарек его бестолковым. Затем началась история о том, как Хироки становится великолепным мастером исцеления, который может уклоняться от самых жестоких атак боссов.
description.pt-br: Um estudante universitário, Sakurai Hiroki foi convocado para outro mundo para derrotar o Demon Lord. E desde que ele designado como "Sacerdote", seu estado de recuperação inicial foi mais que suficiente para curar qualquer ferida, então ele jogou todos os seus pontos de status em Evasion. Em outras palavras, ele está apontando para uma evasão Healer que nunca vai ser atingido por ataques inimigos. Mas, infelizmente, as pessoas desse mundo não entenderam seu ideal! O rei ficou irritado contra ele e o rotulou como inútil quase imediatamente!E assim, a história de como Hiroki se tornou um Curador estranho que pode até evitar ataques de Dungeon Boss com facilidade começou!!

description.en: Kazuto Ayanokoji is an ordinary high school boy. He spends his days playing online games as a hobby. One day, he discovers the true identity of a friend who is so close to him that they are married in-game. It turns out to be a cool idol from the same class, Rinka Mizuki. As Rinka tries to act as his wife in real life, Kazuto is forced to lead a dizzying life.
description.id: Kazuto Ayanokoji adalah seorang siswa SMA biasa. Ia menghabiskan hari-harinya bermain game online sebagai hobi. Suatu hari, ia menemukan identitas asli seorang teman yang sangat dekat dengannya hingga mereka menikah di dalam game. Ternyata, teman tersebut adalah seorang idola keren dari kelas yang sama, Rinka Mizuki. Saat Rinka mencoba berpura-pura menjadi istrinya di kehidupan nyata, Kazuto terpaksa menjalani kehidupan yang membingungkan.
description.ja:
平凡な男子高校生・綾小路和斗には嫁がいる。ただし、それは趣味のネトゲ世界においてよくあるお話。ところが結婚相手の少女リンの正体がクラスメイトで人気アイドルの『水樹凛香』と判明し！？身バレして関係も終わり――かと思いきや、凛香は現実でも和斗の『嫁』として振る舞い始め……。

「――これからは、リアルでも一緒に居られるわね」
description.vi: Ayanokouji Kazuto là một cậu học sinh cao trung bình thường. Cậu có sở thích là chơi game vào thời gian rảnh của mình. Một ngày, cậu phát hiện ra danh tính thật của người bạn thân mà cậu đã kết hôn trong game. Người đó không ai khác chính là Rinka Mizuki, một idol và cũng là một người bạn cùng lớp của cậu. Trong khi Mizuki Rinka cố gắng để cư xử với cậu như một người vợ, cậu phải trải qua một cuộc sống hằng ngày mệt mỏi.

Aventureiros e monstros são capazes de lutar usando um corpo substituto feito por magia, tornando popular as conquistas de masmorras sem nenhuma morte. Em um continente onde conquistas de masmorras são transmitidas ao vivo, o grupo do qual eu era membro, deveria ser o quarto mais popular do mundo. Porém, me disseram que eu estava impedindo-os de subir para o terceiro lugar. Eu lutei para encontrar outro grupo, até que um dia, uma linda mulher apareceu diante de mim dizendo que tinha um trabalho para mim. Impressionado que suas habilidades eram bem melhores do que as dos meus ex-companheiros, eu acabei aceitando sem saber o que era necessário para o trabalho. Nas profundezas da masmorra mais difícil, o castelo do lorde demônio, um dos Quatro Devas estava a me esperar. Essa é a história do Mago Negro que foi expulso de seu grupo ao entrar para o exército do Lorde Demônio e repelir os heróis.

description.en:
Longing to be a normie, I, Renako Amaori, am finally making my high school debut after working so hard for it. However due to my communication impairment, I have a gloomy aura. And after being in the normie group day in day out, I got so exhausted and said “I can't do this anymore,” and reached my limit!

During that time, I accidentally met the top student of our school. Perfect in face and figure, unrivaled in sword and pen, our school's best high school girl: Mai Odzuka.
We found in each other someone who we could open to and talk about our own troubles. What a nice friend I made, now I can surely get back on my own feet…is what I thought!

"It seems that you, even as a girl, have made me fall in love with you."
What!? Mai suddenly confessed to me. Wait! What about our friendship?

And so, we now have different feelings we can’t tell each other: friendship or a romantic relationship. We’re now presenting each other its benefits and put them into practice to see what kind of relationship works best for us. Will I succeed with a successful high school life…?
description.pt-br: A desajeitada e introvertida Amaori Renako está deixando sua vida solitária no ensino médio para trás, determinada a se tornar uma estudante extrovertida e popular. A glamorosa e confiante Oduka Mai é o oposto total de Renako: rica, despreocupada e literalmente uma modelo fashion. Contra todas as probabilidades, as duas garotas formam uma conexão imediata. Renako acha que pode ter encontrado a melhor amiga dos seus sonhos… até que a confissão de amor de Mai deixa seus sentimentos em parafuso. Renako quer provar a Mai que ser melhores amigas é melhor do que ser namoradas, mas Mai está decidida a convencer Renako de que elas estão destinadas a serem amantes!

Esse é o tipo de entrada que foi aberta. "Sem contar a ninguém sobre esse lugar, eu secretamente me tornarei o mais forte." Este mundo é duro com os nobres da pobreza. biography.en:
Negi Haruba graduated from the manga department of Trident College of Design in 2013. He won an award in the 89th Weekly Shounen Magazine Newcomer Manga Award organized by Kodansha with the one-shot manga [Coward Cross World](https://mangadex.org/title/eea96c98-2334-43bb-9849-a06bfc23353c). The work was published in Magazine SPECIAL 2013 as his debut.

In 2014, he won a Gold Award for the one-shot [Ura Sekai Communication](https://mangadex.org/title/4e5dd510-92e7-400a-a435-e9e554a68642) in the 21st Dengeki Grand Prize sponsored by KADOKAWA and ASCII Media Works. This work was later published in Weekly Comic Dengeki Daioh magazine in September 2014.

On January 25, 2017, wrote yet another one-shot, titled [5toubun no Hanayome](https://mangadex.org/title/a2febd3e-6252-46eb-bd63-01d51deaaec5). Receiving positive responses for his work, an official serialization of the one-shot was announced and published in Weekly Shounen Magazine on August 9, 2017. A year later, the manga series was announced to get an anime adaptation on August 8, 2018, and to be aired on TBS from January 1, 2019. A second season started airing January 8, 2021.

He's married and has a child. 

Friends with [Irohara Mitabi](https://mangadex.org/author/3df36cb8-ac98-43b5-a1cf-3f0c5c1fb4d0). 
Worked as an assistant for [Fujimura Akeji](https://mangadex.org/author/7c4df4b4-ac0d-409f-b348-03677f9d1cf7) in [Kami-sama no Iutoori](https://mangadex.org/title/d68e5a0a-d9ba-4979-aaa7-3a2480bd02b9).

[Utsumi Yae](https://mangadex.org/author/983c8731-e1fc-43e5-86d0-5e8a6cb5197d) and [Naito Marcey](https://mangadex.org/author/0e7373ef-5457-49a1-9236-5550ac73904a) were his assistants in [Rengoku no Karma](https://mangadex.org/title/3adab90d-873b-45f7-84d1-00d56eae0fce) and [5toubun no Hanayome](https://mangadex.org/title/a2febd3e-6252-46eb-bd63-01d51deaaec5) respectively.

Para combater essa situação foram criadas as brigadas de incêndio especiais que enfrentam tais criaturas flamejantes, trazendo paz às suas almas. O protagonista, Shinra, é um desses "bombeiros", no entanto, existe um pequeno detalhe sobre Shinra… Ele também é um desses monstros os quais "pegaram fogo".
description.ru:
Люди стали очень часто умирать от самовозгорания. Причины этого феномена неизвестны. К тому же, люди не просто умирают, а превращаются в огнелюдей — безмозглых монстров, которые становятся причиной ещё больших пожаров. Для борьбы с ними были созданы несколько пожарных отрядов, которые, кроме ликвидации огнелюдей, пытаются выяснить, из-за чего это всё происходит. Именно к одному из таких отрядов и присоединяется главный герой — Кусакабэ Шинра. По некоторым причинам его считают повинным в смерти собственной семьи, и чтобы доказать обратное, он хочет стать героем, которого будут уважать и не бояться. Постепенно набираясь опыта, обретая новых друзей, Шинра вместе с членами его отряда будет пробиваться через все преграды, чтобы раскрыть зловещую тайну феномена самовозгорания…

La chine, qui n'est pas encore unifiée, traverse une grande guerre de cinq siècles. Shin, un jeune garçon contemporain de ces temps violents et houleux, cherche, par la seule force de son épée, à se faire un nom sous les cieux !!!
___
**Kingdom en France, le manga tant attendu ! Véritable phénomène au Japon !**
- Élu meilleur manga au 17e Grand Prix Culturel Osamu Tezuka (2013)
- Meilleur manga seinen vendu au Japon depuis 2015 (source : Oricon)
- 3ème meilleur manga vendu au Japon en 2016 et 2017 (source : Oricon)
description.ja: 時は紀元前――。いまだ一度も統一されたことのない中国大陸は、500年の大戦争時代。苛烈な戦乱の世に生きる少年・信は、自らの腕で天下に名を成すことを目指す！！

Це була епоха 500-річної війни, період ворожих держав. «Королівство» — історія про хлопчину на ім’я Сінь, котрий прагне стати найвеличнішим генералом та про безліч випробувань та скитань, повз які пролягатиме його шлях до мети.
description.pt-br: Milhões de anos se passaram desde os tempos de lendas, quando os mundos dos homens e deuses ainda eram os mesmos. Nestes tempos eram os desejos do homem que mudaram o mundo. É o período da guerra de 500 anos: a Era dos Reinos Combatentes. Kingdom é a história de um garoto órfão e pobre tem o sonho de se tornar um grande general e assim começando seu caminho de provações e derramamento de sangue que o levarão até o topo das lendas!

description.en:
**“—N-No!? Wolka, don’t die—!!”**

Wolka is an adventurer reincarnated from Japan. While exploring a dungeon, he and his party are attacked by an overwhelmingly powerful monster. In order to protect his companions, Wolka suffers critical injuries and is pushed to the brink of death.

At that very moment, he finally realizes the truth:
This world is the dark fantasy manga he once read in his previous life—and he himself is nothing more than a background character, fated to die along with the rest of the party.

Hating bad endings more than anything else, Wolka refuses to accept that fate. Driven by sheer desperation, he fights with everything he has and, against all odds, miraculously defeats the monster. Though he loses one eye and one leg in the process, Wolka feels relieved for having overturned the “party annihilation” ending that was supposed to await him.

But his troubles are far from over.

Since that incident, the girls in his party begin to change.
Their gazes grow unbearably heavy.
Their words become increasingly dangerous.

“I’ll protect you this time, so please don’t leave me...”
“I’ll always stay by your side, senior—okay?”
“I’ve already decided... if it’s for your sake, I’m ready to die.”



This is an isekai story about a reincarnator who believes in absolute happy endings—and the girls who harbor overwhelmingly obsessive feelings toward him.
A darkly emotional otherworld tale themed around 【Emotional Descent】, where the survival he fought so desperately to achieve becomes the very beginning of emotional darkness.
description.vi:
"KHÔNGGGGGGGG!? Wolka, Wolka!? C-con không được chết!! Không được chết đâuuuuuu!!"

Chà, hóa ra đây là thế giới trong bộ manga dark fantasy nọ... Khoảnh khắc nhận ra điều đó, tui đã gần đất xa trời, đứng ngay trước ngưỡng cửa của "kết cục toàn diệt".

Có vẻ như cậu đã chuyển sinh thành một thành viên của một mob party, cái đám lót đường bị quái vật quét sạch ngay đầu một bộ manga dark fantasy nào đó. Vốn dĩ là một kẻ căm ghét "bad end" đến tận xương tủy, cậu quyết bảo vệ đồng đội cho bằng được. Cậu điên cuồng lao vào tử chiến, sẵn sàng bỏ mạng để đánh bại lũ quái vật. Dù phải trả giá bằng mắt phải và chân trái, cậu vẫn kỳ diệu né được "kết cục toàn diệt". Cứ ngỡ mọi chuyện thế là êm xuôi, ai dè...

"Bởi vậy mới nói, tui ổn thiệt mà. Tui không bỏ rơi mấy người đâu, yên tâm. Mấy chuyện chuộc lỗi này nọ cũng dẹp qua một bên đi. Tự nhiên nói muốn dâng hiến tất cả làm tui khó xử lắm đó. Nặng nề quá. Nặng nề quá đi mà!!"

Life in the Great Pulha Woodlands is the very definition of stillness and tranquility—and Aesir's had enough of it! That's right. Aesir isn't quite like the other high elves of the forest. For starters, he remembers living a past life as a human in another world... meaning he's got a taste for meat, adventure, and plenty of other decidedly un-elven things! He's also bored out of his skull after 120 years of the peace and quiet of their serene sylvan lifestyle. So with nothing more than his trusty bow, a bundle of life-giving fruit, and his close bond with the spirits of nature, Aesir leaves the monotony of the forest behind to seek a new life, one that's more his pace.

description.en:
When an infectious epidemic spreads and the student dorms are closed, dejected high schooler Kanata Yoshino is left with nowhere to go. That's when he meets Haruka Hoshikawa, the class's top beauty, waving her phone around in the dead of night at the park... Claiming she's "hopeless with technology" and doesn't know how to connect to the internet, Hoshikawa begs Yoshino for help and invites him to her house—but the truth is, she has an ulterior motive!

*Source: Manga UP! Global*
description.es: El estudiante de instituto Kanata Yoshino, que no sabía qué hacer, se encuentra con Haruka Hoshikawa, la chica más guapa de su clase, que estaba agitando su smartphone sola en un parque en mitad de la noche. Hoshikawa le pide ayuda porque es mala con los aparatos y no sabe conectarse a Internet. Acaba visitando su casa, pero poco sabe él, ¡ella tiene un propósito secreto...! ¡La dulce y romántica comedia de amor de convivencia comienza con la hábil invitación de la joven!
description.ja: とある感染症が蔓延し、学生寮が閉鎖となって途方に暮れていた高校生・吉野叶多は、夜中の公園で一人スマホを振り回すという奇行を見せるクラス1の美少女・星川遥と出会った。機械音痴でネット接続の仕方がわからないと語る星川に助けを求められ、家をお邪魔した吉野だったが、実は彼女には秘めた目的があって──！？
description.es-la: El estudiante de instituto Kanata Yoshino, que no sabía qué hacer, se encuentra con Haruka Hoshikawa, la chica más guapa de su clase, que estaba agitando su smartphone sola en un parque en mitad de la noche. Hoshikawa le pide ayuda porque es mala con los aparatos y no sabe conectarse a Internet. Acaba visitando su casa, pero poco sabe él, ¡ella tiene un propósito secreto...! ¡La dulce y romántica comedia de amor de convivencia comienza con la hábil invitación de la joven!
description.pt-br:
O estudante do ensino médio Kanata Yoshino, que estava perdendo o juízo, conhece Haruka Hoshikawa, a garota mais bonita da sua turma, que estava agitando seu smartphone sozinha em um parque no meio da noite. Ela é ruim com máquinas e não sabe se conectar à internet, e pede ajuda a ele. Ele acaba visitando a casa dela, mas ele mal sabe que ela tem um propósito secreto...!

A doce e romântica comédia de amor de coabitação começa com o habilidoso convite da jovem!

description.en: Childhood friends who've been together since they were little. They both realize their feelings for each other, but they're too close to be honest. What connects them is the I Love You Game that they've been playing since they were little. The conclusion of their love is entrusted to this silly game, where you win if you make the other person embarrassed!
description.fr:
À l'âge de 11 ans, Yukiya et Miku ont commencé un « jeu de l'amour » où le premier qui admet être troublé a perdu. Maintenant au lycée, les amis d'enfance s'adonnent toujours à ce jeu et aucun ne veut reconnaître sa défaite.

Amoureux en secret, ils continuent de se lancer des « je t'aime » et de se taquiner. Mais chaque année, le jeu se corse un peu plus et tous les coups sont maintenant permis...

(Source : Kana)
description.ja:
両片想いの幼なじみ。終わらせるための恋のゲームを始めよう。

幼なじみの、その先へ――くだらないはずの遊びに、二人はありったけの想いを乗せる。近づくほど好きになる。近づくほど言えなくなる。素直になれない二人を繋ぐのは…。子供の頃から始めた『愛してるゲーム』。“照れたら負け”の子供じみたゲームに青い気持ちを精一杯詰め込んで、負けられない戦いが今、始まる。
description.vi: Đôi bạn thuở nhỏ luôn ở bên nhau từ khi cả 2 còn bé. Cả 2 đều nhận ra tình cảm của nhau, nhưng họ quá thân thiết nên không thể thành thực. Thứ kết nối họ là trò chơi "Tớ yêu cậu" mà cả 2 đã chơi hồi còn nhỏ . Kết cục tình yêu của họ sẽ được quyết định bằng trò chơi đơn giản này khi người chiến thắng là người khiến người kia phải xấu hổ.
description.es-la: Se conocen desde que eran niños. Ambos son conscientes de lo que sienten el uno por el otro, pero están demasiado unidos como para ser sinceros. Lo único que les une es el juego "Te quiero" al que juegan desde pequeños. Si haces pasar vergüenza a tu compañero, ¡ganas!
description.pt-br: Amigos de infância que estão juntos desde que eram pequenos. Eles percebem seus sentimentos pelo outro, mas são muito próximos para serem honestos. O que os conecta é seu “jogo do eu te amo”, que eles brincam desde que eram pequenos. O fim do seu amor é decidido nesse jogo simples onde o vencedor é aquele que deixa o outro com vergonha!

description.en: Suimei and two of his best friends find themselves mysteriously summoned to another world. There's a cute princess, magic galore, a Demon Lord that needs to be defeated, and a world that needs to be saved — the works! Too bad Suimei isn't interested. His friends are all too ready to play the parts of heroes, but Suimei just wants to get home. He has an advantage as a magician... but he's in for a rude awakening when he finds out what actually passes for magic in these parts.
description.fr: Un héros est invoqué dans un autre monde depuis le Japon moderne… Et ses deux amis par accident aussi… Yakagi Suimei transporté par erreur, refuse de combattre les armées du Roi Démon … Suivons la rencontre de Felmenia Stingray, magicienne royale, et Yakagi Suimei, Magicien moderne.
description.ja: 現代に生きる魔術師・八鍵水明は、突如現れた魔法陣によって友人とともに異世界へ転移してしまう。だけど勇者として呼び出されたのは友人で、自分はそれに巻き込まれただけ！？水明は魔王討伐の旅に同行することを断り、ありとあらゆる現代魔術を駆使しながら、帰る方法を探しはじめる――。
description.pt:
Baseado em uma série de Light Novel, Isekai Mahou wa Okureteru conta a história de uma jovem maga chamada Felmenia Stingray, que conhece um garoto que está aprisionado por se recusar a ajudar o Herói a derrotar o rei demônio depois de ser convocado (acidentalmente) para um outro mundo. "Romance"  
  


---
description.es-la: Felmenia Stingray es una Hechicera genio. Ella se convirtió rápidamente en la más distinguida Hechicera del Reino Astel después de su descubrimiento de la magia del fuego blanco, que tenía el poder de quemar cualquier cosa. Sin embargo, el mundo está en peligro debido al Rey Demonio. Los Hechiceros de la corte del Reino realizaron un Ritual de Invocación para Héroes y produjeron un Héroe y dos jóvenes, un chico y una chica. A diferencia de la chica, el joven chico se negó a luchar contra el Rey Demonio junto con el Héroe y exigió ser enviado de vuelta a su Mundo. El Reino, enojado con su comportamiento, lo encerró. Ahora Felmenia está ante el joven chico con su magia más fuerte, la Flama Blanca, siendo completamente inútil y le pregunta quién es. Ya era obvio para ella que este hombre era mucho más fuerte que ella. A esto él simplemente respondió. "Yakagi Suimei, un Mago."
description.pt-br: Baseado em uma série de Light Novel, Isekai Mahou wa Okureteru, conta a história de uma jovem maga chamada Felmenia Stingray, que conhece um garoto que está aprisionado por se recusar a ajudar o Herói a derrotar o rei demônio depois de ser convocado (acidentalmente) para um novo mundo.

description.en: Haise is a young boy who has been gifted with an unknown ability. He becomes an adventurer together with his childhood friend Sasha, but is kicked out of the team for being unable to use his ability and being a hindrance. Furthermore, while continuing his solo adventure, he is caught in a trap and falls into dire straits. Just as he is on the brink of death, Haise's ability "Weapon Master" awakens! It is a power that shakes the laws of the world, summoning weapons from another world!?
description.ja: 詳細不明の能力を授けられた少年ハイセ。彼は幼馴染のサーシャとともに冒険者になるも、能力が扱えず足手まといだとチームから追放されてしまう。さらに一人冒険者を続ける最中、罠に嵌められて絶体絶命の危機に陥ることに。 死の淵に立たされたその時、ハイセの能力『武器マスター』が目を覚ます！それは異世界の武器を喚び出すという世界の理をも揺るがす力で！？逆境から始まる、異世界無双ファンタジー開幕！

description.en: Dennosuke Uchimura is a simple Salaryman, who one day is run over by an elderly lady on a scooter and left in the street to die. When he regained consciousness he discovers he was summoned to another world by the Demon King himself, who offers him a position as one of his Four Heavenly Kings. Can Dennosuke survive as a servant of the Demon King, and meet his expectations?
description.ja:
「ここに顕現せよ――ウチムラデンノスケ！！」「………はい？」

冴えないサラリーマン・内村伝之助は、ある日突然魔王のヘッドハンティングで異世界へと召喚される！現代では無能とされ海外に左遷されるような俺をなぜ！？

「今までの働き、全て見させてもらった。貴様には四天王としての価値がある！！」

魔王からの熱烈アタックと好待遇に心動かされたウチムラは異世界の魔王軍への転職を決意するのだが！？チート能力は何もなし。サラリーマン時代に培った知識と経験を武器に魔王軍の業務へと挑む――！！

description.en:
Reito Harukaze, who had climbed to the highest rank of adventurers, had retired. One day, as he was thinking of living a quiet, retired life, a beautiful gal named Karen Hiiragi appeared before him.

"Hey, mister, buy me a meal!"

Upon hearing that Karen was in trouble with money, Reito decided to give her a basic lecture on dungeon conquering.

"Thanks to you, I was able to conquer my first dungeon! Master!"

He actually wanted to retire and live a slow life...
description.id:
Reito Harukaze, yang telah naik hingga ranking tertinggi adventurer, telah pensiun. Saat ia berniat untuk hidup santai dan pensiun, suatu hari seorang gadis gal cantik bernama Karen Hiiragi muncul di hadapannya.

"Hey, onii-san, traktir makan dong!"

Mendengar bahwa Karen kesulitan uang, Reito memutuskan untuk memberinya pelatihan dasar tentang cara menaklukkan dungeon.

"Berkatmu, aku berhasil menyelesaikan dungeon pertamaku! Sensei!"

Padahal sebenarnya ia ingin pensiun dan menikmati hidup santai…
description.ja:
冒険者ランク最高位まで上り詰めながらも引退した春風黎人(はるかぜれいと)。隠居してゆっくり過ごそうと考えていた彼のもとに、ある日美少女ギャル・柊火蓮(ひいらぎかれん)が現れる。

「ねえ、おにーさん、ご飯奢って！」

火蓮がお金に困っていることを聞いた黎人は、彼女のためにダンジョン攻略の簡単なレクチャーをすることに。

「おかげで初のダンジョン攻略ができました！師匠！」

本当は隠居してスローライフをおくるはずが、新米冒険者の女の子に好かれてしまい、さらに同居して生活の面倒も見ることになって――！？
description.pt-br:
Reito Harukaze, que havia ascendido ao posto mais alto de aventureiro, havia se aposentado. Um dia, enquanto pensava em viver uma vida tranquila e aposentada, uma bela moça chamada Karen Hiiragi apareceu diante dele.
"Ei, senhor, me pague uma refeição!"
Ao saber que Karen estava com problemas financeiros, Reito decidiu dar-lhe uma palestra básica sobre conquista de masmorras.
"Graças a você, consegui conquistar minha primeira masmorra! Mestre!"
Ele realmente queria se aposentar e viver uma vida tranquila...

description.en: Main protagonist is Tsurumi Asuta. 17 yrs old, 2nd year high schooler. He was working as an apprentice cook at Tsurumi-ya, managed by his father. One day a fire broke out in Tsurumi-ya, for the sake of his father's cherished knife 'Santoku Houchou' he ran back inside to retrieve it and thus met his end. Before he knew it he awoke to an unknown environment. He was then attacked by a beast resembling a boar but a girl named Aifa, from the People of Morihen, saved him. It was then that he realized he was really in different world.
description.ja: 父親の経営する大衆食堂の見習い料理人、津留見明日太（つるみあすた）は、父親の魂とも言える三徳包丁を火事から救うべく火の海に飛び込んだ。そして気づけば、そこは見知らぬ密林の真っ只中。イノシシにそっくりの野獣ギバに襲われ、『森辺の民』を名乗るアイ＝ファという少女に救われた明日太は、そこが異世界だということを知る。ガスコンロも冷蔵庫も存在せず、人々はただ生きるためにモノを喰らう。「食事」の喜びが忘れられた異郷で、見習い料理人が無双する！
description.ru: Цуруми Асута – 17-летний школьник, сын хозяина харчевни «Цуруми-я», попадает в другой мир, где его ждут свирепые монстры, прекрасные туземки и отличная еда!
description.pt-br: Asuta Tsurumi de 17 anos de idade e no segundo ano do ensino médio. Trabalha como aprendiz de cozinheiro no Tsurumi-ya, um restaurante comandado por seu falecido pai. Um dia Tsurumi-ya é pega por um incêndio, Asuta mergulha nas chamas em busca da faca 'Santoku' de seu pai, que lhe foi dito que era a alma e vida dele, e foi ai onde ele encontrou seu fim. Enquanto volta para sair das chamas, ele se deparou que estava em meio a uma floresta estranha, sem entender nada ele foi atacado por uma besta aparecida com um Javali, entanto ele foi salvo por uma bela mulher chamada Ai Fa que se auto-denomina parte do "Povo de Morihen". Neste instante ele percebeu que se encontrava em outro mundo.

description.en:
Dias fulfilled his parents' will to help others, and kept fighting on the battlefield to that end. Now known as the "Savior Hero" from his long wartime career, he was rewarded with a vast territory from the king. After having met the horned Kijin (鬼人) girl Aruna who lives there, he begins his new slow life as a lord, seeking to thrive in spite of increasingly realizing that he was rewarded with the short end of the stick.  
___

description.es: Dias cumplió con la voluntad de sus padres de ayudar al prójimo, y peleó en el campo de batalla hasta el final. Ahora conocido como el "Héroe Salvador" debido a sus hazañas de guerra, fue recompensado con un vasto territorio por parte del rey. Después de conocer a la joven de cuernos Kijin (鬼人) Aruna, que vive allí, él comienza su nueva vida como el terrateniente, buscando prosperar a pesar de darse cuenta cada vez más de que lo recompensaron dándole gato por liebre.
description.ja: 長きに渡る戦争での活躍から“救国の英雄”と称された男・ディアス。彼に与えられた報酬は、広大な領地――のみであった。現地に暮らす鬼人族の少女・アルナーと出会った彼は、領主として第二の人生を歩み始める。
description.pt-br: Dias cumpriu a vontade de seus pais em ajudar os outros e continuou lutando no campo de batalha até o fim. Agora conhecido como o "Herói Patriótico" de sua longa carreira em guerra, ele foi recompensado com um vasto território do rei. description.en:
High school student Hojo Saito married his classmate, Sakuramori Akane, the girl who's his worst enemy in school.

"If you tell the rest of the class we’re married, I'll kill you."
"I don't want them to know either. There’s no point in that."

Their newlywed life wasn't going so well, and they were constantly at odds. However, as they progress through their daily lives, the distance between them closes, they have more enjoyable moments together, and they gradually come to understand one another. Saito learns about Akane's cute side, which he never saw before, and Akane gradually began to recognize the feelings that she’s been keeping inside...

“Nếu cậu nói với cả lớp rằng chúng ta đã kết hôn, tớ sẽ giết cậu.”
“Tớ cũng không muốn họ biết đâu. Chẳng có ích gì cả.”
Cuộc sống hôn nhân của họ không diễn ra suôn sẻ và họ thường xuyên xung đột. Tuy nhiên, khi họ cùng trải qua những ngày tháng thường nhật, khoảng cách giữa hai người dần thu hẹp lại, họ có nhiều khoảnh khắc vui vẻ bên nhau hơn, và dần dần bắt đầu hiểu nhau hơn. Saito bắt đầu khám phá ra những khía cạnh dễ thương của Akane mà trước đây cậu chưa từng thấy, còn Akane cũng từ từ nhận ra những cảm xúc mà cô ấy đã giữ kín bấy lâu...
description.pt-br:
O estudante do ensino médio Hojo Saito se casou com sua colega de classe, Sakuramori Akane, a garota que é seu pior inimigo na escola. 

“Se você contar ao resto da turma que somos casados, eu mato você” 

“Eu também não quero que eles saibam. Não há sentido nisso. ” 

A vida de recém-casados não estava indo muito bem e eles estavam constantemente em conflito. No entanto, à medida que avançam em suas vidas diárias, a distância entre eles diminui, eles passam momentos mais agradáveis juntos e, aos poucos, passam a se entender. Saito aprende sobre o lado fofo de Akane, que ele nunca tinha visto antes, e Akane gradualmente começou a reconhecer os sentimentos que ela estava guardando… 

A vida de recém-casado comovente de duas pessoas que simplesmente não conseguem ser honestas uma com a outra começa aqui!

description.en:
Yamada Kenichi, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a "Hell Mode" — a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential.

Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him. description.en:
On the outside, otome villainess Liselotte seems foul in every way, a purely evil character. However, as revealed in her diary, she was always hiding both her pain and her true feelings for Prince Siegward. While she keeps this locked away, an evil witch ultimately possesses her, leading to her demise—a tragic end for the tsundere villainess. This is how the story always goes, an end coded into the game MagiKoi.

Broadcasting club members Aoto Endo and Shihono Kobayashi decide to play this game. In another universe, Prince Siegward hears their voices, believing it to be a divine revelation from a god and goddess. These voices clue him into something he never noticed before: Liselotte is actually overwhelmingly adorable!

There are no resets in this game, and just one chance to change the future for the ill-fated villainess. In years to come, these two entities, who would guide the country to prosperity and greatness, would be known as play-by-play Endou and color commentator Kobayashi!

(Series cancelled due to a dispute between the original work's author and the manga's publisher.)
description.ru:
«Она всегда делает такое унылое лицо, даже если она не расстроена! Ох, ну почему она не может быть честна сама с собой?»  
  
«В конце концов, она цундэрэ! Когда уровень её смущения превышает определенный порог, она не может сдержать себя. В любом случае она пытается сказать, что она не против прикосновений, если это не у всех на виду.»  
  
Пока Эндо-кун пытается самостоятельно пройти игру, Кобаяши-сан упорно стремится пробиться через цундере-защиту своей любимой героини — леди Лизелотт, «главной злодейки» отомэ-игры «Магикой».  
  
Но неожиданно появился тот, кто может слышать их голоса — наследный принц Сигурд, жених Лизелотт. Именно здесь и начинается история.
description.vi:

『Cô ấy tsundere mà. Khi cô ấy quá bối rối rồi vượt quá một giới hạn nhất định thì cảm xúc của cô ấy sẽ bùng nổ ra. Điểm thú vị nhất là cô ấy vẫn thể hiện một chút sự thành thật ở những nơi ít người.』
Trong khi Endo-kun đang nhiệt tình phản ứng lại với những biểu cảm khôi hài của Lady Liselotte - nhân vật phản diện trong một trò chơi otome game, thì Kobayashi-san lại nói về cách phá vỡ lớp tsundere đó của cô nàng.
Đột nhiên, một nhân vật trong game có thể nghe được giọng nói của họ; Vị hôn phu của Liselotte, Hoàng tử Siegward.
Đó là nơi mà câu chuyện này bắt đầu.

Name is Inori Takafuji. I'm not really much of a "go-getter," if you catch my drift — sleep's more my style — but getting summoned to another world kinda messed things up. Bit hard to chill when you’ve got a king in your face telling you there’s a bad guy you've gotta go slay or whatever, you know? Plot twist, though — it's actually not so bad. Getting the hero treatment sounds pretty nice, right? But then it happens again! Some other clown summons me, I get my obligatory superpower, and off I go.

And sure, that's fine. It happens, sometimes you get isekai'd to the wrong place. But then it happens AGAIN! Someone ELSE summons me, I get ANOTHER superpower, and then I'm somewhere totally new. Repeat ad nauseam. No idea what's going on, but all I want is one thing: stop !@#$ing summoning me!

Noel, un joven que admira a su abuelo, que fue aclamado como un gran héroe, aspira a ser un buscador fuerte como él. Pero el trabajo que apareció en su evaluación, fue la clase de soporte “Talker” (Orador).

Talker es un trabajo con las habilidades individuales más débiles. Un trabajo que nunca podría convertirse en el más fuerte.

「Si creo el clan más fuerte y me convierto en el líder del clan, entonces esencialmente seré el más fuerte」

Pensando eso, y gracias al apoyo de su abuelo, Noel trabajó y entrenó arduamente por años con el objetivo de cumplir su ambición. Por otro lado, los métodos crueles que empleó por el bien de su ambición fueron reconocidos como inhumanos. Sin embargo, el talento distintivo de Noel atrajo a muchas personas poderosas y comenzaron a reunirse debajo de él...

Esta es la historia del Talker más despiadado que busca ser el más fuerte, forjando aliados para crear el clan más fuerte del mundo.

description.en:
The golden age of treasure hunters who seek wealth, honor, power and glory, and explore dungeons around the world without regard to the danger. "Lets be treasure hunters," said Cry Andolihy, who swore an oath with his childhood friends to become the strongest... but he discovered during his first quest that he has no talent. But that was only the beginning of his adventure.  
  
"I can't do this anymore. I want to quit."
"Oh, I see. In other words, we should fight harder and cover for you, that's a good handicap."  
"Rest assured, Cry. We'll protect you!"  
"Oh, wait. If you step on that, the trap will destroy you without leaving a speck of dust behind. Be careful, Leader!"

Protected by his overpowered childhood friends, sought out by newbies and nobles, they aim to be heroes and find powerful treasures. Will Cry really be able to retire safely from being a Treasure Hunter?
___

description.en: A poor high school boy, Izuki Tomonari, got caught up in a kidnapping attempt on Hinako Konohana, a young lady from one of Japan's largest conglomerates. On the surface, Hinako appears to be a brilliant and beautiful young woman, but in reality, she is a lazy girl with no life skills. However, due to family reasons, Hinako has to play the role of the "perfect young lady" at school. Wanting to protect her, Izuki took on the job of caring for her. Eventually, Hinako began to spoil Izuki with all her might. "I don't want... Izuki to leave my side right now."
description.ja: 男子高校生・友成伊月は、誘拐に巻き込まれたことが切っ掛けで、日本随一の財閥のお嬢様・此花雛子のお世話係をすることに。 表向きは才色兼備な雛子だが、その正体は生活能力皆無のぐうたら娘だった。しかし、家の都合で、学院では「完璧なお嬢様」を演じなければならない雛子。そんな彼女を守りたいと思い、甲斐甲斐しく世話を焼く伊月。やがて雛子も伊月に全力で甘えてくるようになって――「今は……伊月が傍にいない方が、嫌」ギャップ可愛いお嬢様との主従を越えて始まる恋物語。
description.pt-br: O estudante do ensino médio Itzuki Tomonari se envolveu em um sequestro e se viu lidando com Konohana Hinako, a herdeira do maior conglomerado do Japão. Hinako parece ser uma jovem inteligente e bonita, mas sua verdadeira identidade é preguiçosa, sem capacidade para viver sozinha. No entanto, devido às circunstâncias em casa, Hinako tem que interpretar a "ojou-sama perfeita" na academia. Uma história de amor que começa além de mestre-servo com uma linda jovem.

description.de:
Sieh die Welt mit neuen Augen!

Yataro Yaguchi hat gute Noten – aber keine Leidenschaft. Er trinkt, raucht und treibt sich bis nachts in der Stadt herum. Aber glücklich macht ihn das nicht. Und nun, kurz vor dem Schulabschluss, muss er sich fragen, ob das wirklich alles ist, was er vom Leben zu erwarten hat.

Da kommt er durch einen Zufall mit der Malerei in Kontakt – und plötzlich sieht er die Welt mit anderen Augen. Ohne jede Erfahrung beschließt er, sich für eine Kunstakademie zu bewerben. Doch die Aufnahmeprüfung ist hart… und ihm bleibt nicht mehr viel Zeit!
description.en:
Yatora is the perfect high school student, with good grades and lots of friends. It's an effortless performance, and, ultimately... a dull one. But he wanders into the art room one day, and a lone painting captures his eye, awakening him to a kind of beauty he never knew. Compelled and consumed, he dives in headfirst — and he's about to learn how savage and unforgiving art can be!
___
- **Won the 13th Manga Taisho Award in 2020**  
- **Won the 44th Kodansha Manga Award for General Manga in 2020**
description.es:
Es un estudiante de bachillerato espabilado, popular, que saca muy buenas notas y tiene ideas pragmáticas sobre su futuro. También bebe, fuma y sale de juerga por las noches. Y un día, de repente, descubre el gozo de dibujar.

¡Esta es la historia de superación de Yatora Yaguchi, repleta de vicisitudes en su camino para aprobar el examen de ingreso a una universidad de arte, en una versión de la tenacidad deportiva aplicada a las bellas artes!
description.fr:
Yatora est un lycéen studieux à qui tout réussit. Pourtant, il ressent depuis toujours une impression de vide en lui. Jusqu’au jour où, par hasard, il tombe sur un tableau qui le subjugue littéralement… Très vite, Yatora réalise que peindre est le seul moyen de faire passer ses émotions et de se révéler. Cet événement le pousse à se livrer corps et âme à la peinture pour tenter le concours d’entrée de la plus sélective des écoles de Beaux-arts !

---

Maison d'édition FR : **Pika**
description.it:
Un liceale dalla vita piena, che prende buoni voti, sa sempre come cavarsela, beve, fuma e ama la vita notturna... un bel giorno, sente dentro di sè risvegliarsi la passione per il disegno. Inizia così la storia di un ragazzo che farà ardere la propria gioventù, aspirando a entrare in un'università d'arte!

Prima tiratura con in regalo il Quaderno d'artista.
description.ja: 成績優秀かつスクールカースト上位の充実した毎日を送りつつ、どこか空虚な焦燥感を感じて生きる高校生・矢口八虎（やぐち　やとら）は、ある日、一枚の絵に心奪われる。その衝撃は八虎を駆り立て、美しくも厳しい美術の世界へ身を投じていく。美術のノウハウうんちく満載、美大を目指して青春を燃やすスポ根受験物語、八虎と仲間たちは「好きなこと」を支えに未来を目指す！
description.pl:
Ma doskonałe stopnie i świetnie radzi sobie w życiu towarzyskim. Czasami pije, pali i bawi się do białego rana. Jest popularny. Nie można sobie wyobrazić lepszych doświadczeń w liceum, więc dlaczego ktoś taki nagle zapałał miłością do sztuki?!

Oto początek opowieści o młodym, przepełnionym pasją chłopaku, który celuje w uniwersytet sztuki, i jego walecznych przygotowaniach do egzaminów wstępnych na studia!
description.pt: Excelentes notas e sociável. Por que esse estudante colegial popular que ama beber, fumar e sair à noite e parecia estar satisfeito com sua vida despertou para a alegria de pintar? A história de um jovem vestibulando que está dando tudo de si para entrar na Universidade de Artes começa aqui!
description.ru:
Можно ли увлечься чем-то настолько, что ради этого вдруг решишь свернуть с намеченного ранее жизненного пути? Если вдруг поймешь, что выбранная до этого дорога, хоть и сулила благополучие в будущем, но не отражала истинного желания?  
С виду безалаберный Ятора Ягути на удивление своих друзей-разгильдяев преуспел в учёбе и по окончании школы мог поступить почти в любой университет. Однако сам парень большой радости от этого не испытывал. Велика задача — подтянуть предметы, нужно только приложить немного больше усилий, чем остальные. Скучно. Да и по мнению парня, гордиться тут нечем…  
Жгучая потребность в самореализации и отсутствие очевидного способа самовыражения так и довлели бы над Яторой, если бы однажды вечером пагубная привычка не привела его в школьный клуб изобразительного искусства. Увидев там картину Мори, он решает попробовать запечатлеть на холсте приглянувшийся ему городской пейзаж. Неумелая, нелепая, но старательно написанная картина всё же достигает сердец некоторых людей, и парень понимает, что таким образом, через искусство, может по-настоящему общаться с другими.  
Так стоит ли ради этого сворачивать с намеченного пути, даже если, вполне возможно, эта другая дорога в конце концов приведёт к пропасти?

description.en:
The people of this world are given occupations and weapons called Divine Treasures by God. It was said that the treasure was very strong and couldn’t be compared to the Human-made weapons. That’s why, occupations which were called “Blacksmith”, who can make and modify weapons are called the weakest.  
  
The main protagonist Relius who has acquired such a weakest job. He gave up on becoming an adventurer and worked in an inn, but he realized that he could make “Anything”. While making things he liked, he found himself in relationships with famous aristocrats and beautiful girls.
description.pt-br: As pessoas deste mundo recebem profissões e armas chamadas Tesouros Divinos de Deus. Dizia-se que esses tesouros eram muito poderosos e incomparáveis ​​às armas criadas pelos humanos. Por isso, a profissão de ferreiro, que consiste em fabricar e modificar armas, é considerada a mais fraca. O protagonista, Relius, é um desses que conquistou uma dessas profissões. Ele desistiu de se tornar um aventureiro e passou a trabalhar em uma estalagem, mas percebeu que podia criar "qualquer coisa". Enquanto criava o que gostava, envolveu-se com aristocratas famosos e belas moças.
